user_story:
As a user, I want to view and sort products in the product catalogue so that I can find the items I want more efficiently.
Acceptance Criteria:
1. The product catalogue presents a list of items with the ability to sort them by 'Name (A to Z)', 'Name (Z to A)', 'Price (low to high)', and 'Price (high to low)'.
2. The sorting options are accessible via the selector [data-test="product-sort-container"].
3. I can add a product to the cart using the button with the text 'Add to cart'.
4. The button to add a product has a unique ID, such as 'add-to-cart-sauce-labs-backpack'.
